## What managing Hyde Park takes.

### Lakefront high-rise operations
East Hyde Park towers along Lake Park Avenue and South Shore Drive combine elevators, staffed entries, life-safety systems, and lakefront weather exposure. We organize those moving parts through preventive schedules, inspection calendars, and board-ready reporting.

### Capital planning for older buildings
Hyde Park's vintage masonry condominium associations need disciplined plans for facades, roofs, windows, risers, boilers, and elevators. We connect reserve assumptions to an actual multi-year project calendar instead of waiting for failures.

### Financial clarity for active boards
Hyde Park boards tend to ask detailed questions and expect decisions to be documented. Monthly variance reporting, bid comparisons, open-item registers, and clear meeting packets give directors the information to act confidently.

## Hyde Park boards ask us first.

### Does CenterPoint manage Hyde Park high-rise condominium buildings?
Yes. Our high-rise program covers building systems, staff and vendor coordination, life-safety and inspection calendars, resident operations, emergency response, monthly financial reporting, and long-range capital planning.

### Can CenterPoint help a Hyde Park association plan facade, riser, roof, or elevator work?
Yes. We coordinate reserve-study inputs, develop a phased capital calendar, prepare comparable bid packages, track board approvals, and oversee authorized work. CenterPoint does not add a separate capital-project planning or management-oversight fee.

### Does CenterPoint manage associations in Hyde Park?
Yes. CenterPoint Association Management provides condominium, HOA, and townhome association management in Hyde Park, Chicago (ZIP 60615, 60637). Every association gets a dedicated manager, monthly financial reporting, and board support grounded in Illinois association law.

### How much does association management cost in Hyde Park?
Management starts at $20 per unit per month, quoted as a flat monthly fee based on your association's size, building systems, financial complexity, and service scope. It is never a percentage of your budget. See [pricing](https://www.centerpointmgmt.com/pricing) for what drives the fee.

### How does a Hyde Park association switch to CenterPoint?
Plan on a managed 30 to 60 day transition after your board gives notice under its current contract. We retrieve records from the outgoing manager, set up banking and vendor relationships, notify owners, and open board and resident access. ### How should a Hyde Park board compare management companies?
Compare at least three firms on the same terms: an active Illinois community association management firm license, a licensed manager, a flat monthly fee in writing, after-hours emergency coverage, and a written transition plan.
